intro.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Ventura that shows you the picture first
paragraphs: Kitchen Places has handled kitchen remodeling in Ventura since 1993 from its showroom at 1500 Callens Road. It is a full-service design-build firm, so the same team designs your kitchen and supplies and installs the cabinetry, countertops, plumbing, appliances, tile, flooring, lighting, glass and hardware.

Clients keep mentioning one thing: they saw the kitchen before it was built. One Ventura homeowner wrote that Jeff could create pictures of the proposed remodel, and her kitchen looked like the picture, only better. Then a detailed workflow chart shows when each stage starts and ends, so you know what to expect each day.

services.h2: Kitchens, baths and whole homes from Kitchen Places

items.name: Kitchen Remodels
items.blurb: From a small galley to a full layout change with walls moved and plumbing relocated. One past client gained a walk-in pantry after the team moved plumbing and appliances in a 35-year-old kitchen. Cabinet lines include Nickels, Bellmont and Medallion.

image.alt: Simple + Serene kitchen in Ventura County with a rift-cut white oak island, honed quartzite counters, white cabinets and woven-seat counter stools

items.name: Bathroom Remodels
items.blurb: Primary baths, guest baths and powder rooms, with tile, glass, plumbing fixtures and lighting chosen in the showroom. Radiant heating from WarmlyYours is available for floors, mirrors and towel racks. Repeat clients often come back for the bath after the kitchen.

image.alt: Scalloped Waves bathroom with a white clawfoot tub, teal fish-scale tile wall, wood bath caddy and a wall-mounted tub filler

items.name: Whole-House and Guest House Remodels
items.blurb: Kitchen Places brings designers, architects, engineers, craftsmen and technicians to larger projects. Its portfolio includes a coastal guest house, living rooms, laundry rooms and multi-room remodels that tie the kitchen and baths together into one consistent look.

image.alt: Coastal Guest House kitchen with a white waterfall-edge island, rattan bar stools, white cabinets and ocean artwork

items.name: Townhomes, Condos and Mobile Homes
items.blurb: Small spaces get the same design attention as big ones. The portfolio includes a Ventura tri-tone townhouse and a full mobile home makeover, and one client said her small kitchen job still made her feel like an important customer.

image.alt: Mobile home kitchen makeover with gray lower cabinets, white uppers, a white quartz peninsula, woven stools and open shelving

items.name: Cabinets, Counters and Windows
items.blurb: As an authorized dealer, Kitchen Places supplies and installs Nickels, Bellmont and Medallion cabinets, Cambria, Caesarstone and Silestone quartz, and Pella windows and doors. You can see and compare them at the Callens Road showroom before choosing.

image.alt: English Charm kitchen with Bellmont alabaster cabinets, a sand-colored tile backsplash and a diamond checkerboard Marmoleum floor

about.h2: Jeff King: Coast Guard veteran, UCSB graduate, Ventura craftsman
about.text: Jeff King has owned Kitchen Places since 1993. He served four years in the U.S. Coast Guard, then earned a B.A. in Environmental Studies at UC Santa Barbara. Ventura's coastline and the Channel Islands brought him here after college. Jeff is a creative craftsman who loves working out the smallest details so the fit and finish are never compromised. One Google reviewer called him a master craftsman with a phenomenal staff. He leads a team of designers, a design assistant and project managers who supervise every installation.

image.alt: Kitchen Places showroom building with a stone tile facade at 1500 Callens Road in Ventura, CA

process.h2: Six steps, from the showroom to the celebration

steps.title: Visit the showroom
steps.text: Your first meeting is a chance to see the team's work in person and try the cabinet, counter and fixture brands they carry.

steps.title: Getting to know you
steps.text: The team visits your home to see the space firsthand and hear how you cook, store and gather before any planning starts.

steps.title: Broad strokes
steps.text: Designers put preliminary concepts on paper and in the CAD system, so you can see the layout before committing to it.

steps.title: The finishing details
steps.text: Hardware, finishes, lighting and every special detail get filled in, and the final plans are set before installation.

steps.title: Build and celebrate
steps.text: Project managers run the install with a flow-chart based system, then you get to enjoy the finished kitchen or bath.

items.text: After quite a bit of investigating, we settled on Kitchen Places to remodel our 35-year-old kitchen. They were wonderful. We moved plumbing, created a walk-in pantry, and moved appliances to create a much more efficient and beautiful kitchen.

service_area.text: The Callens Road showroom sits in Ventura, and most Kitchen Places projects are in Ventura County. Past clients write in from Ventura, Camarillo, Thousand Oaks and Oak View, and project names point to East Ventura, Midtown and Surfer's Point. Since 1993 the team has designed and installed kitchens and baths across southern and central California, so call if you live farther out.

faq.h2: Questions Ventura homeowners ask before they remodel

items.q: Will I see my kitchen before it is built?
items.a: Yes. After the team visits your home, designers sketch preliminary concepts and develop them in a CAD system. Clients say this is what they value most: one wrote that her kitchen looked like the picture, only better, and another said there were very few surprises during construction.

Yes, through Finance by Cambria. You can bundle Cambria quartz surfaces with other remodel products and services for up to $75,000. The application is paperless and takes under 10 minutes, with no prepayment penalties, no application fees and no closing costs. Ask the team how to get approved.

items.q: How do I know the job will stay on schedule?
items.a: You get a detailed workflow chart that shows when each stage starts and finishes, and installation runs on a flow-chart based system. Clients have said the staff stuck to the schedule, cleaned the work area every day and finished on time.

items.q: Which brands can I choose from?
items.a: Kitchen Places is an authorized dealer for Nickels, Bellmont and Medallion cabinetry, Cambria, Caesarstone and Silestone quartz, Pella windows and doors, and WarmlyYours radiant heating. You can compare door styles, slabs and finishes side by side at the Ventura showroom before deciding.

The showroom at 1500 Callens Road is open Monday through Friday, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m., and Saturdays by appointment. It closes for major holidays, including Thanksgiving weekend and Christmas. Call (805) 658-0440 to schedule your visit with a designer.
